title: Tangled Threads
summary: Debug a relationships script: cor.test's odd formula, an outcome and predictor swapped, a package not loaded, and χ² handed raw columns.
hints: "'formula' missing or invalid": `cor.test()` has no outcome, so its formula has nothing on the left: `cor.test(~ efficacy_t1 + efficacy_t3, data = pd)`.
`vif()` comes from car. And read the comment above `lm()`: which variable is being predicted?
"invalid 'type' (character)": `chisq.test()` wants a table of counts, `table(pd$programme, pd$experience)`, or the two columns as separate arguments.
